zlib.<107 top-level constants and aliase: not a gap: they are non-enumerable on Node's zlib, so Node's ESM namespace (what the probe imports) omits them; thaw exposes them like Node CJS and @types/node
crypto.fips / prng / rng / pseudoRandomB: not a gap: same non-enumerable (deprecated) case as zlib; present on thaw like Node CJS
module.stripTypeScriptTypes: needs a TypeScript type stripper inside the runtime bundle; not available to node:module
module.findPackageJSON: declared but not implemented at runtime (needs node:fs/url in the node:module bundle, which would be pulled into every bundle that uses node:module)
v8.Serializer / Deserializer / DefaultSe: V8 wire format; thaw's v8.serialize uses its own graph format, so a byte-compatible Serializer class is a separate project
v8.promiseHooks: needs promise lifecycle hooks in the engine; a registration-only stub would silently never fire
v8.queryObjects: needs heap enumeration by constructor prototype
http2.performServerHandshake: needs the raw-socket HTTP/2 server session API
process._events.* / process.argv index p: probe artifacts or Node-internal state (listener tables, loaded internal bindings)
arity: callback-typed or overloaded decl: an extra optional parameter breaks the native lowering (http.createServer) or overload resolution (fs.readFileSync); arity_sync.py lists them as skipped: child_process.exec/execFile/execFileSync, dns.lookup, crypto.scrypt/randomBytes/randomInt, assert.rejects/doesNotReject, fs.readFile/watch/stat/lstat/writeFile/readdir/readFileSync/readdirSync, fs/promises.readFile/readdir, http.createServer, timers/promises.setTimeout/setImmediate, zlib.zstdCompress/zstdDecompress
dns.lookupService service names: dns.promises.lookupService maps only the common well-known TCP ports (no /etc/services reader); other ports return the number
